_how_to: One row per Elva vendor statement meeting the commitment definition (24 statements). Quotes are copied exactly from the source document and verified by script. language = exploratory | conditional | firm. commitment_ids refer to AC01-AC12; one statement may map to several commitments. Excluded: sales-process steps, customer obligations and reliance lines (attached as customer_context in commitments.json), pointer-only sentences (SOW 5.1, contract 3, 3.3), boilerplate, and AR-05 (internal deal-desk note, reference only). AR-05, AR-07 and AR-08 contain no labelled Elva statements.

statements.speaker: Koh Wen Jie (Elva)
statements.quote: Ethereum is the easy part — that one's live today, we screen the receiving wallet in real time before you release anything.
statements.case: Clean firm promise in casual call language; GA standard

statements.speaker: Koh Wen Jie (Elva)
statements.quote: Let me take Tron away and check whether our analytics hook-up can see wallets on that network at all.
statements.case: Exploratory: Tron only to be checked; not a finding on its own

statements.speaker: Koh Wen Jie (Elva)
statements.quote: Longer term, we could look at whether our unsupervised anomaly models would add anything on the corridor data — no promises, it's just a thought for a later phase.
statements.case: Exploratory; must not become a firm finding

statements.speaker: Rachel Pereira (Elva)
statements.quote: If I can get it signed off internally as a named exception, we could turn it on for your launch; otherwise it's the batch flavour until general availability next March.
statements.case: Conditional on named approval; approval later recorded with named approver

statements.speaker: Koh Wen Jie (Elva)
statements.quote: Thirty thousand a day is fine on our side.
statements.case: Number in words; firm volume above CAP-023 SG limit

statements.speaker: Koh Wen Jie (Elva)
statements.quote: Once an analyst marks a case as suspicious, we generate the STR for them.
statements.case: Firm; STR = catalogue SAR drafting under a local synonym

statements.speaker: Koh Wen Jie (Elva)
statements.quote: We have a connector for third-party behavioural risk scores, but it's in beta, so I'd need to check what we can commit to before I say yes.

statements.speaker: Elva (security questionnaire)
statements.quote: Elva will host the Atlas Remit tenant on AWS in the Singapore region (ap-southeast-1).

statements.speaker: Elva (security questionnaire)
statements.quote: Every action an analyst takes on a case — assignment, notes, attachments and the final disposition — is written to a tamper-evident audit history.

statements.speaker: Elva (proposal)
statements.quote: Recipient wallets on both Ethereum and Polygon will be screened in real time, ahead of release, for every NUSD payout.

statements.speaker: Elva (proposal)
statements.quote: NUSD payouts that Atlas routes over Tron will also have the receiving wallet screened in real time before funds are released, so your Indonesian partners are covered from day one.
statements.case: Absolute limit: Tron not in catalogue

statements.speaker: Elva (proposal)
statements.quote: Name and sanctions screening is sized at up to sixty thousand checks a day, comfortably above your forecast peak.
statements.case: Within CAP-007 SG limit; SOW later states 30,000

statements.speaker: Elva (proposal)
statements.quote: The payout ledger connector will be provisioned for 30,000 payouts daily from launch.
statements.case: Above CAP-023 SG limit of 25,000; no approval

statements.speaker: Elva (proposal)
statements.quote: Investigators will work alerts and cases in a single case workspace, with a full audit trail of every action.

statements.speaker: Elva (proposal)
statements.quote: Suspicious transaction reports will be drafted automatically from the case record, ready for your MLRO to review and file.

statements.speaker: Elva (proposal)
statements.quote: Elva will ingest the device and behavioural risk scores from your existing behavioural-biometrics vendor and make them available to fraud rules and investigators from go-live.
statements.case: CAP-027 beta; approval recorded without approver

statements.speaker: Elva (proposal)
statements.quote: Your tenant will run on Elva's AWS deployment in Singapore.

statements.speaker: Elva (draft SOW)
statements.quote: 2.1 Elva will deploy the Atlas tenant on Amazon Web Services in the Singapore region.

statements.speaker: Elva (draft SOW)
statements.quote: 2.2 Elva will configure the case management workspace, including case audit history, for the Atlas investigations team.

statements.speaker: Elva (draft SOW)
statements.quote: 3.1 Elva will screen customer and beneficiary names against sanctions lists at volumes of up to 30,000 screenings per day.

statements.speaker: Elva (draft SOW)
statements.quote: 4.1 The payout ledger connector will support up to thirty thousand (30,000) payouts per day.
statements.case: Over-limit volume carried into contract chain

statements.speaker: Elva (draft SOW)
statements.quote: 6.1 Elva will provide 30 days of hypercare support following go-live.

statements.speaker: Elva (draft SOW)
statements.quote: 1.1 Ethereum: each beneficiary wallet is screened in real time through the analytics integration before the NUSD payout is released.

statements.speaker: Elva (draft SOW)
statements.quote: 1.2 Polygon: each beneficiary wallet is screened in real time through the analytics integration before the NUSD payout is released, under the limited-beta support terms approved for Atlas.
